text:
Cole Perfetti's role has finally caught up with his draft slot. The 10th pick in 2020 is playing 17:58 a night, up from 15:37, and he's been on the ice for 89% of Winnipeg's power-play chances after 50% last season. The result is 20 points in 25 games, half of them on the power play, including a power-play goal against the Islanders on Nov. 19.

The chances came with the role, which is why this breakout looks sturdier than most. His own expected goals (the quality of his shots) are up to 1.41 per 60 from 1.08, and his 9 goals trail the 10.6 his looks were worth. He ranks 25th of 559 skaters in wins added by his goals.

Two things to watch. His minutes have dipped 1:26 a night over the last ten, and he has no points in his last two games. And our talent range puts him around 2.1 points per 60 over time, below his current 2.67, so some cooling in the rate is normal even if the role sticks. Evolving-Hockey had him taking chances away last season (95th percentile), which helps keep him on the ice when the points slow.
